country_overview: Singapore operates one of the most liberalised and open foreign-exchange regimes in the world. There are no exchange controls or restrictions on current or capital account transactions for residents or non-residents. The framework is administered by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS).

summary.traveler: Travelers may bring in or take out unlimited amounts of Singapore Dollars and foreign currency. No general currency declaration is required for normal travel amounts.
summary.business: Businesses and individuals enjoy full freedom to hold, transfer, convert and repatriate foreign currency through authorised banks and financial institutions.

rules.bring_foreign_currency_in: Unlimited amounts of Singapore Dollars and foreign currency may be brought into Singapore with no general declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.take_foreign_currency_out: Unlimited amounts of Singapore Dollars and foreign currency may be taken out of Singapore with no general restriction or declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.cash_declaration_threshold: No mandatory currency declaration threshold applies for ordinary travelers. Large or suspicious cash movements are subject to anti-money laundering reporting requirements by financial institutions.
rules.resident_holding_rules: Singapore residents may hold and maintain foreign currency accounts freely with authorised banks and financial institutions.
rules.non_resident_rules: Non-residents may open and operate foreign currency accounts and transfer funds freely without prior approval.
rules.business_invoicing_settlement: Business transactions may be invoiced and settled in foreign currency or SGD. Cross-border payments and repatriation of funds are handled freely through authorised financial institutions.
rules.exchange_controls: Singapore maintains no exchange controls. The regime is fully liberalised for both current and capital account transactions.
rules.banking_conversion_practicality: Foreign exchange conversion and transfers are widely available through banks, licensed money exchange houses, and ATMs throughout Singapore.
